q: Can switching a coal boiler to a biomass boiler qualify for a green loan?
title: Green loan readiness for a biomass boiler
short: It can, if the lender accepts the project as renewable energy or fuel switching and you can show a sustainable, documented biomass supply. Expect questions on fuel source, expected CO2 cut, air pollution control and how you will report results. Lenders decide; terms are never guaranteed.
audience: MSMEs planning to replace coal boilers with biomass

ul: Current coal use and CO2 from bills or registers.
Biomass type, source and supply contracts.
Expected fuel use and CO2 after the switch.
Emission control equipment and consent to operate.
No proof the biomass is residue or sustainably sourced.
Plans to keep burning coal alongside without limits.

p: Build a baseline of coal use for at least twelve months before you apply.

senseible: Senseible turns your bills into a dated, traceable emission record, the baseline a lender reads before it looks at a green project. Lenders decide; finance is never guaranteed.
